## What kind of change does this PR introduce?

Bug fix.

## What is the current behavior?
(See #14990)

On [the Postgres Extensions Overview page](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/extensions#full-list-of-extensions), not all extensions have links, and some links are incorrect.
 

## What is the new behavior?

Unneeded extensions have been removed and all extensions now have the appropriate link (externally or to one of our guides).

(closes #14990)
 
## Additional context

issue_context.title: Docs: Extension search returns incorrect links
issue_context.body:
## Describe the bug

The [extensions search component](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/extensions#full-list-of-extensions) in the docs return incorrect links for some of the extensions.

## To Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior, please provide code snippets or a repository:

1. Go to https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/extensions#full-list-of-extensions
2. Type 'cron' in the extension search box
3. Click on the `pg_cron` card
4. See 404 error

## Expected behavior

We expect the links to navigate to valid pages. In the above example, the real page lives on `/pgcron`, not `pg_cron`.

## Additional context

There are a number of other extensions that have the same problem. We're pretty inconsistent with naming (ie. some extensions use snake case, others are all lowercase with no separator).

**At a minimum:** Fix the broken links
**Also consider:** If it is worth bringing some consistency to our extension names. Will need to add redirects in `www` if we decide to rename URL paths.
comments:
I'd like to take this on!

It looks like there are quite a few extensions listed in [`extensions.json`](https://github.com/supabase/supabase/blob/master/apps/docs/data/extensions.json) that don't have pages in [`/pages/guides/database/extensions`](https://github.com/supabase/supabase/tree/master/apps/docs/pages/guides/database/extensions). 

How should we handle those? Should we only create links for extensions with a `link` property? It looks like the commented-out code [here](https://github.com/supabase/supabase/blob/master/apps/docs/components/Extensions.tsx#L121-L126) took a similar approach.

review_comments: Did a few tiny TypeScript cleanups, hope that's okay!
Only external links will have this property. If it exists, use that. Otherwise, use a relative link to our docs using the extension's name.

Thoughts on making `link` required and including both internal and external URLs in `extensions.json`? Feels like we could benefit from the simplicity of less moving parts (and less opportunities to accidentally link to a broken URL).

Worth noting we will likely share `extensions.json` with the dashboard to do something similar (after this PR is merged):
#15431

Internal links could be relative:
```json
{
  "name": "pg_cron",
  "comment": "Job scheduler for PostgreSQL",
  "link": "/guides/database/extensions/pg_cron",
  "tags": ["Utility"]
}
```

Makes sense to me to be more explicit! 

I'll make that change tonight when I resolve the merge conflicts.
